read.thesis: Emerson's Q4 orders rose 14% with backlog up 11% to $8.2B and a 1.01 book-to-bill, but China and Europe stay weak and 2027 sales guidance is held at about 5%.

triggers.label: Underlying orders +14% in Q4
triggers.quote: Underlying orders grew 14%. With broad based demand across all business groups.

triggers.label: Backlog $8.2B, up 11% YoY
triggers.quote: Backlog ended the quarter at $8.2 billion, up 11% year over year. And our book to bill was 1.01

triggers.label: 2027 price assumed at 2%
triggers.quote: we feel pretty good about 2% price in the plan. Normal level of pricing.

triggers.label: China orders negative
triggers.quote: China orders remain negative as both chemical and refining continue to weigh on demand.

triggers.label: Backlog 12-month share 75% to 70%
triggers.quote: That dropped to 70%. So it is a. Your point is a good 1

guidance.quote: For the full year, we are guiding GAAP and underlying sales growth of approximately 5%.
We expect adjusted segment EBITDA margin of 29%, up 80 basis points year over year.
We are guiding 2027 adjusted earnings per share of $7.25 up 10%
free cash flow of $3.8 billion to $3.9 billion
we plan to return approximately $3.8 billion to shareholders through $2.5 billion of share repurchase, and $1.3 billion in dividends
adjusted earnings per share of $1.58 to $1.62

red_flags.label: Corporate expense overrun $45M in Q4
red_flags.quote: we were about $45 million higher than we had expected to be.

red_flags.label: China petrochemical exposure, no recovery modelled
red_flags.quote: We are not planning for a recovery in China due to the persistent headwinds in both chemical and refining.

evasions.topic: Q1 top-line conservatism vs accelerating orders
evasions.quote: that is where the conservatism really lies in.
